def get_movie_schedule():
    url = 'http://www.example.com/movieschedule'
    response = requests.get(url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    movies = {}

    for movie in soup.find_all('div', class_='movie'):
        title = movie.find('h3').text
        if title not in movies:
            movies[title] = []
        showtimes = [time.text.strip()
                     for time in movie.find_all('span', class_='showtime')]
        movies[title] += showtimes

    return movies
